ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (dark) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Numerous circular low-intensity blobs (rosettes) scattered across a high-intensity field; dark pigmentation is concentrated along the trailing edge and central peduncle region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 35 degrees and a depth approximately 15% of the fluke's vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude sawtooth pattern along the entire trailing edge, with peaks and valleys ranging from 3 to 10 pixels in amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the median notch extending to sharp, acute lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed circular high-contrast rings and spots (rosettes) distributed throughout the ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct sets of dark, parallel linear pixel streaks (rake marks) visible on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring characterized by dense circular barnacle marks and linear rake marks across both visible fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Exceedingly sharp, pointed lateral fluke tips and a dark continuous border along the trailing edge.
